description_en: Queries the list of affected assets from virus defense check results
description_zh: 病毒防御检查结果中，查询受影响的用户资产清单
name: DescribeAffectedAssets

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 20. If this parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned.
>Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，pagesize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
>建议pagesize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The severity level. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
- serious: urgent
- suspicious: suspicious
- remind: reminder
parameters.help_zh:
紧急程度。多个采用英文半角逗号隔开，取值：
- serious：紧急
- suspicious：可疑
- remind：提醒
parameters.name: levels
